id: MOTSCALE: one inequality for pushes, sustained hand loads and the robot's own arm motion - the delay factor multiplies the remaining support margin; the motion's information cost is an estimator-specific coefficient
registered: 2026-11-11, before any evaluation run. Dev evidence: (i) motscale_offline.py on MOTLD motion-only logs (peak spurious estimate vs peak arm inertial force: kappa 0.14 ours, 0.41 centroidal + IMU); (ii) three smoke runs on dev seed 1300 (swing at playback speed 0.5/1/2): the peak arm force at 0.5 came from the motion-onset blend (2.0-2.05 s) and peaks scale about linearly with speed (linear frame interpolation), the median about quadratically - hence all decisions use the measured arm force, not the speed, and the window starts at 2.6 s.
model: Proposition 1 as a margin budget, one direction: holdable iff |delta_push| <= exp(-omega L) (b - b_load - b_motion(t_push)); information condition: spurious estimate = kappa_est * F_arm within the error tolerance. Without load and motion this is Proposition 1.
fall criterion: CRITERIA_FC.json; runs use permissive stops (tilt 1.2 rad, height 0.4 m) and are scored with fc_rescore.score; held in place = recovered and no step before the end (summary steps, as BUDF)

conditions.M: ACCAD swing arms, speed 1.0, from 2 s

part A (true push force delayed; evaluat.pushes: 0.2 s at 3 s; lateral y+ 40-90 N, fore-aft x+ 25-70 N, 5 N steps
part A (true push force delayed; evaluat.metric: holdable force F*: 50 % crossing of the held-in-place fraction, linear interpolation on the grid (budf_analyze.py rule; censored if the lowest force is below 50 % or no crossing)

part B (closed loop, final configuration.motions: ACCAD swing and jab from 2 s at playback speed s = 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0 (opt-in upper_motion speed)
part B (closed loop, final configuration.metrics: window 2.6-6.0 s: peak and median arm inertial force (both arm subtrees, 2nd derivative of their CoM in the torso frame, Savitzky-Golay 55 ms; horizontal); peak spurious estimate (horizontal d6 minus its 1.0-1.9 s mean)

predictions.D1 (primary): for L, M and LM: |F*(L)/F*(0) - exp(-omega L)| <= 0.08 at L = 20 and 40 ms, both directions (12 checks, met if all pass; censored boundaries count as failed)
predictions.D2 (primary, additivity): with Delta_X = F*_Q(0) - F*_X(0): |Delta_LM - (Delta_L + Delta_M)| <= 7.5 N in both directions
predictions.D3 (part B, primary): kappa_CI / kappa_OURS >= 2, kappa = least-squares slope through the origin of the peak spurious estimate on the peak arm inertial force over all runs of the estimator
predictions.D3m (manipulation check): the median arm inertial force increases monotonically with s for both motions (pooled over estimators and seeds); if not, D3 is reported as not interpretable
predictions.R (reported): F*_X(0) relative to Q; Q vs BUDF d0 boundaries; per-sample correlation and lag of the spurious estimate with the arm force; peak spurious estimate of OURS against the 15 N white-noise tolerance at each speed

analysis: motscale_analyze.py (written before the runs); runner run_motscale.sh
